==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''May 7th - May 8th, 2015''
**Single Round Robin
**Each team plays 5 matches
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**1st to 4th place will play the Playoffs
* '''Playoffs''' - ''May 9th - May 10th, 2015''
** Single Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
